_about: Narration languages and Kokoro v1.0 voices. A voice name starts with its language prefix and f or m. 'speed' is the default Kokoro speed of a voice, set so the narration lands at 2.3-2.7 words per second while speaking; 'rate' says how it was measured. 'names' lists the Kokoro v1.0 voices of a language, as read from the pinned voices-v1.0.bin. Voices without an entry use speed 1.0.
